name: skillroute
description: Find the right skills for your next task. SkillRoute indexes your local SKILL.md library and returns ranked matches with confidence, reasons, and source evidence.

defaultPrompt: Find the best skills in my library for this task
Show which skills match this project
Explain why these skills fit my request
interface.longDescription:
Find the right skills for your next coding task. SkillRoute indexes the SKILL.md bundles you already use and ranks matching skills with confidence scores, reasons, and source evidence. Search your library, inspect a skill before using it, and get clarifying questions when a request is ambiguous.

The default catalog and route traces stay on your machine. Index your skills once, then ask your agent which ones fit your task. Requires Node.js 20+ and uv or an installed SkillRoute Python command. The optional Astra DB backend sends queries to your own database when you select it.

Published by JEStats. Maintained by Eric Hare.
